svg.title: Why four A, five B and five C cubes cannot build a five-colour target
svg.desc: The only possible targets are A, B and C themselves. Target A has five corner types that occur on no other variety, so it needs five A cubes, but only four are available. Targets B and C each have six private corner types but only five copies.

g.text: Corners are read counterclockwise from outside. Faded types also occur on another variety.
Each net folds away from you; its centre face is +x. The paper shows that only A, B and C can be targets.
